title: Cheese Ravioli with Roasted Red Pepper and Pistachio Pesto
changes_from_base: Jarred roasted red peppers, toasted pistachios, basil and parmesan are blended into a pesto that replaces the butter sauce, with shop-bought cheese ravioli in place of homemade.
summary: Cheese ravioli in a warmly coloured pesto of sweet roasted peppers, basil and toasted pistachios.

ingredients.item: jarred roasted red peppers, rinsed and patted dry
fine sea salt or table salt
fine sea salt or table salt, for the cooking water

steps.title: Boil
steps.text: Heat around 4000 ml water to a rolling boil in a large pot.

steps.title: Blanch
steps.text: Add 2 unpeeled garlic cloves and boil 1 min, cool under cold water, then peel and mince.

steps.title: Cook
steps.text: Slide 680 g cheese ravioli in with 1 tbsp salt and cook until al dente, stirring regularly; save 120 ml of the water, then drain and return the ravioli to the pot.

steps.title: Blend
steps.text: Run 20-30 pulses over the garlic, 250 g rinsed roasted red peppers, 20 g basil, 40 g parmesan and 65 g pistachios until finely ground, scraping down the bowl.

steps.title: Stream
steps.text: As the motor runs, add 60 ml olive oil in a slow stream until fully worked in.

steps.title: Season
steps.text: Add ¼ tsp salt along with ¼ tsp black pepper.

steps.title: Toss
steps.text: Fold about 240 ml of the red pepper and pistachio pesto gently through the ravioli, adding cooking water a tablespoon at a time to loosen, and pass the remainder separately.

tips: Dry the peppers well so the pesto doesn't become watery.
Pistachios go into this pesto, so warn anyone with a nut allergy.
Scan the ravioli packet for egg.
storage: Keep leftover pesto chilled under a film of oil for up to 2 days. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
